rows.title: Brand deal rate card: 5 things to price separately
rows.caption:
Stop quoting one flat number for brand deals. Save this before your next one 💸

A flat fee hides 5 things that should each have a price:
1. Deliverables: every reel, story and post listed
2. Usage rights: can they run your content as ads? For how long?
3. Exclusivity: are you blocked from working with competitors?
4. Revisions: how many rounds are included
5. Rush: a shorter deadline costs more

Put each one on its own line. When a brand pushes back on price, you remove a line instead of cutting your rate.

rows.title: Teach Claude your caption voice with a custom skill
rows.caption:
Comment IDEA and I'll DM you a free Claude skill you can install today 📩

Tired of re-explaining your style to AI every single time? Build a skill once:
1. Make a folder with a Skill.md file
2. Top of the file: a name and a description ("use when I ask for captions")
3. Paste your 5 best captions + your rules (no emojis in line one, max 3 hashtags...)
4. Zip the folder and upload it in Settings > Capabilities > Skills

Now Claude loads it on its own whenever you ask for a caption. Code execution needs to be on.

Want a ready-made one? Comment IDEA for my free Reel Idea Machine skill. Follow so the DM lands.

rows.title: Stop endless client revisions with a 3-line clause
rows.caption:
"Just one more small change" is how projects never end. Save this 👇

Add these 3 lines to every proposal:
1. Includes 2 rounds of revisions.
2. Extra rounds are billed per round.
3. Feedback is due within 3 working days, or the timeline moves.

Send it before you start, not after round six. Clients don't push back on rules they agreed to up front.
